precondition_sources.text: The launchpadLPVault address can be changed/updated post-deploy via updateLaunchpadLPVault().
The factory stores launchpadLp as a constructor-time constant, fixed at construction.

intent_sources.text: The vault used as the addLiquidity() recipient must always match the address embedded in pairs via the factory.
If configurability is required, pair and factory launchpad configuration must be rotatable so existing and future pairs track the current vault/distributor.
Pairs should query the current launchpadLPVault() and distributor() from Launchpad at use-time when computing/distributing fees, eliminating configuration drift between components.
